title: Hypothetical bias

definition.text: Hypothetical bias is the distortion in values people state in surveys about goods they do not actually have to pay for or give up.

facts.text: A public health study found hypothetical bias is greater when people have less information about a good and information is costly.
Stated willingness to pay is lower when hypothetical bias is high, widening the gap between willingness to accept and willingness to pay.
John A. List studied whether explicit warnings remove hypothetical bias in elicitation procedures.
